description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for notes in a local database, using Android Room library annotations. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting note entities, with both reactive (Flow) and non-reactive methods.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Interface defining DAO operations for notes, including reactive and non-reactive queries, insert, update, delete, and transaction support.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of all non-deleted notes, ordered by update time descending.

methods.name: observeSearch
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of notes matching a search query on title or content, supporting SQL LIKE wildcard escaping.

methods.name: observeById
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a single note identified by id, or null if not found.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve a note by id, preserving createdAt and update semantics.

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve a list of notes marked as dirty (unsynchronized changes).

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a single note into the database.

methods.name: upsertAll
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a list of notes into the database.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and dirty, updating its timestamp.

methods.name: markClean
methods.description: Marks a list of notes as clean (synchronized).

methods.name: purgeDeleted
methods.description: Deletes all notes marked as deleted from the database.

methods.name: upsertInTransaction
methods.description: Performs an upsert of multiple notes within a transaction.
